primary.label: Main service
primary.title: Animated story shorts for YouTubers
primary.summary: I turn your scripts into finished animated shorts for your channel, so you can keep a steady upload schedule without animating anything yourself.
points: Your script or idea turned into a vertical short, ready to upload
The same characters and sets across episodes, so your channel looks consistent
Works for one-off videos or a monthly package of episodes
Draft for feedback before the final render, with revisions agreed upfront
Characters and animations made for your channel, with ownership agreed in writing

steps.d: Send the story, a rough idea or a reference video.
Pick the characters, sets and style for your channel.
You see the animation early and can ask for changes.
The finished short, ready to upload.

services.title: Character rigging
services.summary: Rigs that animate cleanly, for Roblox characters or your own custom characters.
points: Tested with animations before I hand it over

services.title: Dev and game-ready animation
services.summary: Animations built to be used inside a Roblox game, and help getting them working.
points: Idles, walks, combat moves and emotes made for in-game use
Set up and exported so they work in Roblox Studio
Roblox game development help when you need it

addons.label: Add-ons
addons.sub: Add these to any project. I do not sell them as stand-alone services.

services.title: Modelling
services.summary: UGC items and custom models for your characters, props and sets.

services.title: Texturing
services.summary: Textures and materials for the models in your project.

contact.title: Have a project in mind?
contact.sub: Message me with what you are making, how many videos or characters you need, and when you want them.
